questions.question: Read the passage and answer the following questions: On this Independence Day, the atmosphere resonates with both solemnity and jubilation as citizens from myriad walks of life converge to celebrate India’s remarkable journey towards sovereignty. The Prime Minister, addressing the nation from the historic Red Fort, underscored the myriad sacrifices made by unsung heroes whose steadfast dedication catalyzed the country’s transformation. As tricolour flags flutter aloft and patriotic melodies permeate the air, a palpable sense of unity and resilience envelops the populace. However, the commemoration is not devoid of introspection; while recalling the arduous struggles and adversities that punctuated the freedom movement, the Prime Minister exhorted citizens to transcend parochial interests and foster a progressive ethos. “Let us uphold the tenets of liberty and justice for all,” he proclaimed, emphasizing the necessity of inclusivity and ethical governance. The ceremony culminated with a resounding salute to those who laid the foundation for a democratic and pluralistic society. Yet, this auspicious occasion also serves as a clarion call to confront contemporary exigencies—be it preserving national integrity, mitigating social discord, or adapting to global challenges. Hence, Independence Day is simultaneously a tribute to bygone valour and a fervent reminder of the collective responsibilities incumbent upon every Indian citizen, as the nation navigates a complex and evolving landscape. 1. Which word in the passage is most similar in meaning to "arduous"?
